agent_summary: I reviewed the Gracie Barra Jiu-Jitsu Fundamentals (GB1) class webpage provided on the application. The program was confirmed to be a subject-based, recreational martial arts class open to the general public with no college credit or clinical therapy component. However, the website does not publish class pricing or a specific schedule with days and times. Because no fee structure is publicly available on the site, the requested rate of $189 per month could not be verified against published rates. The reviewer will need to obtain direct documentation or local school pricing confirmation from the provider for fee and schedule verification.
checklist_notes: Invoice guideline: more than 2 sessions/day (up to 60 min each) or more than 7 sessions/week at one provider requires prior approval.
Classes must relate to a habilitative need in the Life Plan — not purely recreational.
